content:
200
Returned if the Tenable MSSP Portal successfully retrieved the list of domains and their details for the
specified account UUID.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
string <uuid>
The UUID of the specified account.
Array of objects (Response-Domains-Details-List-Object)
An array of domain objects.
— 404 Returned if the Tenable MSSP Platform could not find the specified customer account.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
500 Returned if an internal error occurred in the Tenable MSSP Portal.
